name: Information and Communications Engineering (M.Sc.)
university: Hamburg University of Applied Sciences (HAW Hamburg)
tuitionText: No tuition fees; only the semester contribution
semesterContribution: 397 EUR (incl. semester ticket / Germany-wide rail pass)

deadlines.text: Application period 1 June–15 July (winter semester)
Application period 1 December–15 January (summer semester)

deadlineNote: Same deadline for all applicants. Applicants with foreign certificates must first obtain a VPD (preliminary review documentation) from uni-assist, which takes 4–6 weeks, and then apply online at HAW Hamburg (myHAW) within the application period; the online system is only open during the application period.
englishRequirement: English B2 (CEFR); no specific test score stated on the programme page
admissionRequirements: Bachelor's/Diplom in electrical engineering and information technology, information engineering, renewable energy systems, computer science for technical systems, mechatronics or a comparable subject; holders of 180-ECTS degrees must earn 30 extra ECTS in the first two semesters (waived with 6+ months relevant work experience).
description: A practice-oriented master's linking electrical engineering, electronics and IT, covering communications networks, mobile communications, digital signal processing and high-frequency technology, with about 40% of required-module time in labs and team projects and a third-semester master's project tied to departmental R&D.

excludeReason: other: international applicants must prove German at DSH-2 level in addition to English B2 (bilingual programme)
name: Bioeconomy (M.Sc.)

tuitionText: Not stated on programme pages (Mecklenburg-Vorpommern public university, no tuition fees)

name: Microelectronic Systems (M.Sc.)

name: Sustainable Energy – Specialisation in Development (SEDev) (M.Eng.)
university: Europa-Universität Flensburg (jointly with Flensburg University of Applied Sciences)
duration: 3 semesters (90 ECTS) plus a mandatory pre-semester
beginning: Winter semester (pre-semester starts 1 September; no spring intake)
tuitionText: No tuition fees; a semester fee is payable each semester (amount not stated on the pages seen)

englishRequirement: B2 or higher: TOEFL iBT 80 / IELTS 6.0 in all bands / Cambridge FCE / PTE Academic 59–75 (an English-medium degree certificate alone is not sufficient)

name: Artificial Intelligence & Robotics (M.Sc.)
